text:
jessica_support: Hey team, we just got a customer escalation — Ember v1.2.0 onboarding shows p95/p99 spikes for requests with >32k tokens. They say it started after the tokenizer chunk-splitting change.

omar_sre: Noted. Any request IDs or sample payloads?

jessica_support: Attached sample call: POST /v1/generate model=ember-1.2 ctx=65536, request_id=rq_0a9f3. Error observed: long tail latencies, many 10s-30s responses. No 5xxs from app layer.

li_infra: I pulled the traces: a lot of time spent in auth middleware revalidating bearer token with our token-introspect endpoint. Seeing ~3 retries per request due to transient 401 from cache stampede.

nate_ml: Hmm tokenizer change introduced chunk-splitting earlier in pipeline, so requests hit KV-cache warm path more often. That combined with the auth revalidate spike could amplify tail.

jessica_support: Customer says billing meter is miscounting when the chunk splits are high — they saw doubled embedding charges.

billing-bot: @jessica_support Detected duplicate meter events for requests with >3 chunk parts in the ember tokenizer path between 2026-03-12T13:00-13:40Z. Creating ticket BILL-4721.

omar_sre: OK, triage plan: 1) reproduce in staging, 2) confirm whether tokenizer chunking increases auth calls or leads to duplicate meter events, 3) mitigation = route customer to ember-1.1 or fallback model and roll back tokenizer change if needed.

li_infra: Repro steps I ran in staging: curl example payload with long context -> observe p99 ~ 7.8s. Adding header X-Debug-Trace shows repeated auth:introspect calls. Sample trace snippet:

```
AUTH: start -> cache miss -> introspect -> success
TOKEN_CACHE: race -> delete -> introspect (again) -> success
INFER: kv-cache load -> chunk-split process -> runtime exec
```

nate_ml: Do you have the tokenizer config used? The new splitter emits 4 parts for this prompt; before it emitted 2. More KV lookups + metadata tagging.

jessica_support: Customer provided logs showing doubled billing events for the same request_id. Looks like the meter plugin is invoked per chunk.

li_infra: That explains meter duplication. The billing instrumentation hooks into the chunk processing loop; we missed dedupe across a single request. I can patch to dedupe by request_id before emitting meter events. Patch PR incoming.

omar_sre: For immediate mitigation, route the customer to ember-1.1 (no chunk-splitting) and enable a short-rate-limit on introspect endpoint to avoid retries cascading. Also scale token-introspect instances temporarily.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: infra/token-introspect autoscale +2 replicas -> deploy id deploy-7845

li_infra: Patch for billing dedupe: add in-memory LRU per request_id for 60s to suppress duplicate meter events; will push hotfix to staging now.

nate_ml: Also pushing a small tokenizer config tweak to keep chunk count lower for long contexts until we finish instrumentation. PR: models/ember/tokenizer#125 (canary).

jessica_support: Customer notified — switched them to ember-1.1, awaiting confirmation. They reported p99 drop immediately from ~28s to ~2.1s.

omar_sre: Nice. Follow-ups: 1) Increase token-introspect caching TTL and add jitter to cache population to avoid stampede; 2) Add request_id dedupe to billing meter (li); 3) Add metrics: chunk_count distribution + per-request meter emits; 4) Consider moving meter emit to finalization stage rather than per-chunk.

li_infra: Timeline: hotfix to billing dedupe -> staging pass in 30m -> prod roll in 90m if green. Token-introspect scaling already live.

nate_ml: We'll run a targeted regression suite for Ember 1.2 with long-context dataset (10k/20k/50k tokens) to validate p95/p99 before re-onboarding.

jessica_support: Customer confirmed reduced latency on ember-1.1. They've accepted temporary routing while we fix.

omar_sre: Postmortem items: a) missed instrumentation when moving meter hook into tokenizer loop; b) tokenizer change increased chunk fanout without cost accounting; c) auth cache stampede exposed by new hotspot. Assign owners and SLAs.

jessica_support: I'll keep customer updated and close once billing ticket BILL-4721 resolves and we announce re-onboard timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: intro-autoscale replicas=+2 (deploy-7845)

billing-bot: Billing ticket BILL-4721 updated: dedupe hotfix scheduled, temporary credits applied to affected invoices.

li_infra: Hotfix PR: infra/billing/dedupe#230 -> merged to main. Rolling out now.

omar_sre: Marking this thread resolved for now. Will reopen if we see regressions after re-onboard.

jessica_support: closing notes: repro command used in staging:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"ember-1.2","input":"<long-context-file>","max_tokens":1024}' 
```

and the quick-check to see duplicate meter emits in logs: `grep rq_0a9f3 /var/log/billing/emit.log`

jessica_support: thanks team, will file final summary into incidents/ and link BILL-4721. :white_check_mark:
